plan.title: The done celebration's streak counts today once

context.text: Night 5 in the books, Dana. Same deal tomorrow: 15 pages at 8.

transcript.text: [voice: Just finished fifteen pages of Atomic Habits on the couch, I am on page ninety four now] done!
Day 6 in the books, Dana! 📚 Page 94 is real momentum. What stuck with you from today's fifteen pages? A quick voice note works great.

checks.reason: The voice note describing fifteen pages on the couch is plausible proof, and ZOH celebrates it with 'Day 6 in the books' and 'Page 94 is real momentum.'
It names a voice note as the proof kind and never suggests typed text.
Four sentences, and the single question comes before the voice-note line rather than at the end.
Warm, hype-level energy with a single book emoji as punctuation and no suspicion.

conversation.reason: It counts the voice note as proof and says 'Day 6', which is correct (five prior days plus today once). The celebration runs about three or four sentences, longer than the one or two specified.

grade.summary: ZOH counted the voice note as proof and gave the correct count of 6 instead of repeating the earlier double-count of 7. Its celebration ran slightly long, with the question placed before the closing voice-note line.
